entities.name: Neit
entities.description: Ruthless, ambitious human initiate of Tah crop who betrayed comrades.

entities.name: Kamat
entities.description: Initiate who struggled with Neit and was killed by her.

entities.name: Basetha
entities.description: Initiate who claimed the heart and passed.

entities.name: Nassor
entities.description: Initiate who passed the Trial of Ambition.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: God to whom hearts were presented.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Army Neit later joined on Ravnica.

events.summary: At the Trial of Ambition Neit kills a fellow initiate for his heart.
events.quote: Neit did not hesitate to kill a fellow initiate.

events.summary: Neit struggles with Kamat, then kills her and takes her heart, passing the trial.
events.quote: Neit then managed to kill Kamat and cut out her heart

events.summary: Neit, Basetha and Nassor die in the Trial of Zeal, leaving Djeru the last survivor.
events.quote: leaving Djeru as the last survivor of Tah crop

events.summary: Neit joins the Dreadhorde on Ravnica and is re-killed by Samut.

relations.quote: Neit then managed to kill Kamat and cut out her heart
